preserved_content: The ability for a surface to reflect light is called its Albedo.
This means that a surface absorbs (1-A) of the energy falling on it.

critique_regions.label: Heavy colored header
critique_regions.redraw_instruction: Remove the heavy red pill-shaped background. Convert 'January 2024: Albedo' to a quiet metadata eyebrow in gray ink, and promote the subtitle to the main slide title in dark ink.

critique_regions.label: Unstructured text block
critique_regions.redraw_instruction: Convert the loose sentences into a structured hierarchy. Use a core claim for the definition, and extract the Snow/Asphalt math into clean comparison cards using the accent color for data.

critique_regions.label: Clunky default arrows
critique_regions.redraw_instruction: Replace default Office arrows (which have dark outlines and drop shadows) with clean, flat, single-color accent lines. Align '340 watts/m^2' neatly above them.

critique_regions.label: Messy diagram layout
critique_regions.redraw_instruction: Redraw the diagram using strict horizontal and vertical alignment. Use a subtle gray rule for the Atmosphere and Ground lines. Remove the red text 'Causes Heating' and integrate it into a clean label.

critique_regions.label: Distracting footer elements
critique_regions.redraw_instruction: Remove the orange pill shape and decorative blue dots. Set the NASA HEAT and Heliophysics text as quiet, small gray metadata at the very bottom margin.

skill_effect_summary: Eliminated default PowerPoint shapes (pill headers, drop-shadow arrows) in favor of a clean, flat editorial layout.
Enforced a strict palette (neutral paper, dark ink, single blue accent, gray rules) by removing arbitrary red and orange elements.
Transformed unstructured, textbook-style reading paragraphs into scannable comparison cards and concise bullets.
Improved diagram clarity by aligning elements to a grid and using subtle gray rules for environmental boundaries (Atmosphere/Ground).
